x: Nonetheless he came mighty close and was clear of some class track men such as John Robson and Graham Williamson in finishing in 16th place out of a record field of 985 starters.
When compared to outdoor times he has a way to go to catch fellow Scot Graham Williamson's UK best of 3:53.15 from 1979 - but let’s face it, he has two more years to try to reach this goal!
